source.title: U.S. Census Bureau, 2025 TIGER/Line® Area Hydrography
source.license: Public domain: U.S. Government work (17 USC 105)
source.processing: Dissolved, simplified in NAD83 / UTM zone 10N with topology preserved, transformed to WGS84, clipped, and precision snapped.
limitations: Static 2025 statistical hydrography, including intermittent water; not a survey or current tide boundary.
County area-water geometry does not cover the entire Pacific Ocean; the coastal zone extends beyond the application's 3 km interpolation radius.
Single-line streams are absent from area hydrography.
